momentum.py.entrySemantics: Long iff slope_z > threshold, delta > 0, OBI > imbalance, spread_ticks <= max_spread_ticks, and current price strictly exceeds max price of prior window. Short mirrors with slope_z < -threshold, delta < 0, OBI < -imbalance, and price strictly below min price of prior window.
momentum.py.exitSemantics: Not defined in source prototype (research signal only). Backtest harness assigns 35 bps TP, 20 bps SL, 60-bar time exit.

absorption.py.entrySemantics: Candidate spike on history[-1] (volume > baseline mean * volume_multiple, abs(price - baseline[-1].price) <= move_ticks * tick_size, spread_ticks <= max_spread_ticks). Long iff candidate sell fraction > aggression_fraction AND current delta >= confirmation_delta AND current price > candidate price. Short mirrors for buy candidate with current delta <= -confirmation_delta AND current price < candidate price.
absorption.py.exitSemantics: Not defined in source prototype. Backtest harness assigns 40 bps TP, 18 bps SL, 60-bar time exit.

divergence.py.entrySemantics: Trailing extrema over prior window. Long iff current price <= prior min price - divergence_price_ticks * tick_size, current CVD >= prior min CVD + divergence_delta, and current delta > 0. Short iff current price >= prior max price + divergence_price_ticks * tick_size, current CVD <= prior max CVD - divergence_delta, and current delta < 0.
divergence.py.exitSemantics: Not defined in source prototype. Backtest harness assigns 50 bps TP, 25 bps SL, 60-bar time exit.
